The structure of NaMg14Mn crystallizes in the trigonal space group P-31m (No. 143), with a 16-atom unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives all Mg, Na, and Mn centers a 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangement, with neighbor distances near 3.15–3.31 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts show Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Na–Mg polyhedra sharing edges. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
